SAMDependency.description: A resource that depends on the resource that a manifest describes.

kind.description: kind[String]: The SAM kind of the resource that depends on this resource, e.g. LLMClient. Read only.
kind.title: Kind

name.description: name[String]: The name of the resource that depends on this resource. Read only.
name.title: Name

SAMDependency.title: SAMDependency

SAMLLMHostEngineConfig.description:
Spec.engine: the inference server.

The common settings, e.g. ``contextLength``, are translated into each engine's own
arguments, e.g. vLLM's ``--max-model-len`` and llama.cpp's ``--ctx-size``. ``args`` and
``env`` are passed to the engine as they are, for everything else.

apiFormat.description: LLMHost.spec.engine.apiFormat[str]: the wire protocol. One of: ['openai_compatible', 'huggingface', 'ollama_native', 'custom'].
apiFormat.title: Apiformat

args.description: LLMHost.spec.engine.args[list]: additional arguments, passed to the engine as they are.
args.title: Args

command.description: LLMHost.spec.engine.command[list]: overrides the image's entrypoint. For custom engines.
command.title: Command

contextLength.description: LLMHost.spec.engine.contextLength[int]: the maximum context the server allocates, in tokens.
contextLength.title: Contextlength

gpuMemoryUtilization.description: LLMHost.spec.engine.gpuMemoryUtilization[float]: the fraction of GPU memory the server may use.
gpuMemoryUtilization.title: Gpumemoryutilization

image.description: LLMHost.spec.engine.image[str]: the container image. Defaults to the engine's official image. Pin a version in production. Required for custom.
image.title: Image

maxConcurrentRequests.description: LLMHost.spec.engine.maxConcurrentRequests[int]: the requests that one replica serves at once.
maxConcurrentRequests.title: Maxconcurrentrequests

name.description: LLMHost.spec.engine.name[str]: the inference server. One of: ['vllm', 'tgi', 'sglang', 'llama_cpp', 'ollama', 'tei', 'custom'].
name.title: Name

port.description: LLMHost.spec.engine.port[int]: the container port. Defaults to the engine's port. Required for custom.
port.title: Port

tensorParallelSize.description: LLMHost.spec.engine.tensorParallelSize[int]: the GPUs that one replica shards the model across.
tensorParallelSize.title: Tensorparallelsize

trustRemoteCode.description: LLMHost.spec.engine.trustRemoteCode[bool]: run Python code from the model repository. Only for repositories that you trust.
trustRemoteCode.title: Trustremotecode

SAMLLMHostEngineConfig.title: SAMLLMHostEngineConfig

SAMLLMHostHealthCheck.description: Spec.healthCheck: the probes that decide when a replica is ready.

path.description: LLMHost.spec.healthCheck.path[str]: the HTTP health path. Defaults to the engine's, e.g. /health.
path.title: Path

startupTimeoutSeconds.description: LLMHost.spec.healthCheck.startupTimeoutSeconds[int]: the time the server has to download and load the weights before it is restarted. Large models need more.
startupTimeoutSeconds.title: Startuptimeoutseconds

SAMLLMHostHealthCheck.title: SAMLLMHostHealthCheck

SAMLLMHostMetadata.description: Smarter API LLMHost Manifest - Metadata class.

annotations.description:
The manifest annotations. Used for storing arbitrary metadata as
            key-value pairs. Example: [{'smarter.sh/test-manifest/project-name': 'Scooby dooby do'}]. The
            key should be a valid url-friendly string. The value accepts
            multi-line string values (YAML block scalars) and various scalar types including
            str, int, float, bool, datetime.date, datetime.datetime, decimal.Decimal, uuid.UUID, bytes, list, dict.
annotations.title: Annotations

description.description: The description for this resource. Be brief. Keep it under 255 characters.
description.title: Description

name.description: The camelCase name of the manifest resource
name.title: Name

tags.description: The tags of the manifest. Used for generic resource categorization and search. Example: ['tag1', 'tag2']
tags.title: Tags

version.description: The semantic version of the manifest. Example: 0.1.0
version.title: Version

SAMLLMHostMetadata.title: SAMLLMHostMetadata

SAMLLMHostModel.description: Spec.model: what is served, and where its weights come from.

capabilities.description: LLMHost.spec.model.capabilities[object]: what the model can do.

contextWindow.description: LLMHost.spec.model.contextWindow[int]: the model's maximum context, in tokens.
contextWindow.title: Contextwindow

file.description: LLMHost.spec.model.file[str]: a single weights file within the repository, e.g. a GGUF file for llama_cpp. For ollama with a Hugging Face source, the quantization tag, e.g. Q4_K_M.
file.title: File

quantization.description: LLMHost.spec.model.quantization[str]: the weights' precision. One of: ['none', 'fp32', 'fp16', 'bf16', 'fp8', 'mxfp4', 'int8', 'int4', 'gguf', 'awq', 'gptq'].
quantization.title: Quantization

repository.description: LLMHost.spec.model.repository[str]: the model, in the source's terms: a Hugging Face repository id, e.g. Qwen/Qwen3-8B; an Ollama tag, e.g. llama3.1:8b; an S3 prefix, e.g. s3://bucket/models/qwen3; a URL; or, for pvc, a path within the volume.
repository.title: Repository

revision.description: LLMHost.spec.model.revision[str]: a Hugging Face branch, tag or commit SHA. Pin a commit SHA for reproducible deployments. Defaults to main.
revision.title: Revision

servedName.description: LLMHost.spec.model.servedName[str]: the model name that clients send in their requests. Defaults to the LLMHost's name. Ollama always uses repository.
servedName.title: Servedname

source.description: LLMHost.spec.model.source[str]: where the weights come from. One of: ['huggingface', 'ollama', 's3', 'url', 'pvc'].
source.title: Source

task.description: LLMHost.spec.model.task[str]: what the model does. One of: ['text-generation', 'embedding'].
task.title: Task

tokenSecret.description: LLMHost.spec.model.tokenSecret[str]: the name of a Smarter Secret with a Hugging Face access token, for gated models, e.g. Llama and Gemma. You must also accept the model's license on huggingface.co.
tokenSecret.title: Tokensecret

SAMLLMHostModel.title: SAMLLMHostModel

SAMLLMHostModelCapabilities.description:
What the model can do.

Informational, for discovery and for the LLMClients that use it.

functionCalling.description: LLMHost.spec.model.capabilities.functionCalling[bool]: supports tool calls. Some engines also require args, e.g. vLLM's --enable-auto-tool-choice and --tool-call-parser.
functionCalling.title: Functioncalling

SAMLLMHostModelCapabilities.title: SAMLLMHostModelCapabilities

SAMLLMHostNetwork.description:
Spec.network: how the LLMHost is reached.

It is always reachable inside the cluster, at its Service. With ``ingress``, it is also
reachable at ``https://<hostname>``, with a TLS certificate from cert-manager. A public
endpoint requires an API key, unless ``allowUnauthenticated``.

allowUnauthenticated.description: LLMHost.spec.network.allowUnauthenticated[bool]: permit an Ingress for an engine that does not authenticate requests, e.g. tgi and ollama. Anyone who knows the hostname can use the model.
allowUnauthenticated.title: Allowunauthenticated

apiKeySecret.description: LLMHost.spec.network.apiKeySecret[str]: the name of a Smarter Secret with the API key that clients must send as a Bearer token. If omitted, Smarter generates one when the LLMHost is launched, and stores it in the Secret llmhost_<name>_api_key.
apiKeySecret.title: Apikeysecret

hostname.description: LLMHost.spec.network.hostname[str]: the Ingress hostname. Defaults to <name>.llmhost.<account number>.<environment API domain>.
hostname.title: Hostname

SAMLLMHostNetwork.title: SAMLLMHostNetwork

SAMLLMHostResources.description:
Spec.resources: the compute that each replica, one pod, requests.

These are the pod's resource requests, not a node's capacity. They must fit a node of the
LLMHost's compute, which also determines the GPU model.

cpu.description: LLMHost.spec.resources.cpu[str]: the pod's CPU request, e.g. 4 or 3500m.
cpu.title: Cpu

gpuCount.description: LLMHost.spec.resources.gpuCount[int]: the GPUs per replica. 0 runs on CPU.
gpuCount.title: Gpucount

gpuResource.description: LLMHost.spec.resources.gpuResource[str]: the Kubernetes extended resource, e.g. nvidia.com/gpu.
gpuResource.title: Gpuresource

memory.description: LLMHost.spec.resources.memory[str]: the pod's memory request and limit, e.g. 24Gi.
memory.title: Memory

serviceAccountName.description: LLMHost.spec.resources.serviceAccountName[str]: e.g. for IRSA access to an S3 model source.
serviceAccountName.title: Serviceaccountname

tolerations.description: LLMHost.spec.resources.tolerations[list]: Kubernetes tolerations. When gpuCount > 0, a toleration of the gpuResource taint is added.
tolerations.title: Tolerations

vramRequiredGb.description: LLMHost.spec.resources.vramRequiredGb[int]: the GPU memory the model requires. Informational.
vramRequiredGb.title: Vramrequiredgb

SAMLLMHostResources.title: SAMLLMHostResources

replicas.description: LLMHost.spec.scaling.replicas[int]: the replicas. More than one requires storage.accessMode ReadWriteMany or ReadOnlyMany.
replicas.title: Replicas

compute.description: LLMHost.spec.compute[str]: the LLMHostCompute that the LLMHost runs on, e.g. gpu_l4_1x. Defaults to the cheapest one that its resources fit.
compute.title: Compute

SAMLLMHostStatus.description:
Smarter API LLMHost Manifest - Status class.

Read only. Besides ownership, it reports the LLMHost's lifecycle state, where it can be
reached, and its accumulated cost, as of its most recent status check.

accountNumber.description: LLMHost.status.account_number: The account owner of this LLMHost. Read only.
accountNumber.title: Accountnumber

apiKeySecret.description: LLMHost.status.apiKeySecret: the Smarter Secret with the API key, if any. Read only.
apiKeySecret.title: Apikeysecret

created.description: The date in which this resource was created. Read only.
created.title: Created

dependencies.description: dependencies[List]: The resources that depend on this resource, and that must be deleted, or stop referring to it, before it can be deleted. Lists only the resources that you can read. Read only.
dependencies.title: Dependencies

deployedAt.description: LLMHost.status.deployedAt: when it was last launched. Read only.
deployedAt.title: Deployedat

endpoint.description: LLMHost.status.endpoint: the base URL inside the cluster, e.g. for LLMClients. Read only.
endpoint.title: Endpoint

estimatedCost.description: LLMHost.status.estimatedCost: uptimeHours times replicas times each replica's share of its compute's node price. Read only.
estimatedCost.title: Estimatedcost

healthy.description: LLMHost.status.healthy: the result of the last health check. Read only.
healthy.title: Healthy

hostStatus.description: LLMHost.status.hostStatus: the lifecycle state, e.g. pending, active or error. Read only.
hostStatus.title: Hoststatus

lastCheckedAt.description: LLMHost.status.lastCheckedAt: when its status was last checked. Read only.
lastCheckedAt.title: Lastcheckedat

message.description: LLMHost.status.message: why the LLMHost is in its state, e.g. a container error. Read only.
message.title: Message

modified.description: The date in which this resource was most recently changed. Read only.
modified.title: Modified

publicUrl.description: LLMHost.status.publicUrl: the base URL of the Ingress, if any. Read only.
publicUrl.title: Publicurl

recordLocator.description: recordLocator[String]: An optional identifier used to locate the resource record associated with this manifest. Read only.
recordLocator.title: Recordlocator

uptimeHours.description: LLMHost.status.uptimeHours: hours since deployedAt. Read only.
uptimeHours.title: Uptimehours

username.description: LLMHost.status.username: The Smarter user who created this LLMHost. Read only.
username.title: Username

SAMLLMHostStatus.title: SAMLLMHostStatus

SAMLLMHostStorage.description:
Spec.storage: the model volume, a PersistentVolumeClaim mounted at /models.

It caches the weights, so that a restarted server does not download them again. The
cluster's storage class provisions its PersistentVolume.

existingClaim.description: LLMHost.spec.storage.existingClaim[str]: an existing PersistentVolumeClaim to mount, instead of creating one. Required when model.source is pvc.
existingClaim.title: Existingclaim

retain.description: LLMHost.spec.storage.retain[bool]: keep the volume, and its downloaded weights, on undeploy. It is always deleted when the LLMHost is deleted.
retain.title: Retain

storageClass.description: LLMHost.spec.storage.storageClass[str]: defaults to the cluster's default class.
storageClass.title: Storageclass

SAMLLMHostStorage.title: SAMLLMHostStorage

apiVersion.description: apiVersion[String]: Required. The API version of the AbstractSAMBase.
apiVersion.title: Apiversion

kind.description: kind[String]: Required. The kind of resource described by the manifest.
kind.title: Kind

status.description: LLMHost.status[obj]: Optional, Read-only. Stateful status information about the LLMHost.
